about.title: Huntington Beach Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When someone dies because another person was careless, the paperwork arrives long before the grief settles. In Huntington Beach, that reality touched families 15 times in 2025 through traffic deaths alone, based on public collision records. Many of those crashes happened along Pacific Coast Highway and Beach Boulevard, the two corridors that carry the heaviest volume of reported collisions, and they cluster on Saturday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. Not every wrongful death in Orange County involves a car. Unsafe premises, medical errors, defective products and workplace incidents can all support a civil claim. California gives a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children the first right to bring that claim, with certain dependents and heirs able to step in when there is no one closer. The window is two years from the date of death, and it shrinks when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect Huntington Beach families, at no charge, with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so you can ask questions before deciding anything.

whyChoose.title: Why Huntington Beach Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can tell you quickly where your family stands.

items.title: The two-year clock, explained
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to act, and far less if a city, county or state agency may share fault. Knowing which deadline applies protects your claim.

items.title: A civil path, separate from any criminal case
items.desc: A wrongful death claim seeks funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. It moves independently of whatever prosecutors decide to do.

items.question: My relative was killed in a crash on Pacific Coast Highway in Huntington Beach. Do we have to wait for the criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs on its own track, regardless of whether charges are filed or how a criminal case ends. Waiting can actually hurt, because the two-year deadline keeps running from the date of death. If Caltrans or the City of Huntington Beach might be involved, the time to give notice is much shorter.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children have the first right to file. If there is no one in that group, certain dependents and heirs may qualify instead. Because the rules are specific, an attorney will usually confirm standing before anything else.

items.question: What does it cost to talk with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and the independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency. That means no attorney fee unless there is a recovery for your family.
